1.consolidated_definition: Cama de matrimonio. Cama para dos personas, menor que la queen. Anglicismo híbrido, usual. Las cabañas Tienen un baño y dos cuartos, uno con dos literas y el otro con una cama full (Primera Hora, 27-06-04)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Double bed. Bed for two people, smaller than a queen-sized bed. Hybrid Anglicism, commonly used. The cabins have a bathroom and two rooms, one with two bunk beds and the other with a full-size bed (Primera Hora, 27-06-04)
